Definition: probably akin to G5420 through the idea of defining; to indicate (by word or act), i.e. (specially), to expound:-- declare.
BiblicalUsage: Phrazo means to declare, to explain, to indicate, and it appears once, when Peter asks Jesus to explain the parable. Peter says, Declare unto us this parable, and Jesus answers with the teaching that what goes into the mouth does not defile a man, but what comes out of the mouth defiles him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter's request is the disciple's honest prayer: declare it to us, because the parable is not plain until Jesus opens it.
